system.description: Choose one enemy target within 30ft. That target makes a Wiles Check against your Check DC. If they fail, they treat all allies as enemies. Whenever the affected target chooses another creature as a target for its abilities, it must choose at random from among all creatures it can see within range of the ability it is using. If an enemy provokes a reaction attack from the affected creature, the creature must make that attack if it is able to. The affected target makes a Wiles Check against this effect every time you renew Focus. It also makes a Wiles Check against this effect if it takes damage of any kind. When it passes the Check, the effect ends.
